# Kindling α4.1b: Old history has a smaller footprint

## What is new

Spent inputs keep their identity and provenance in immutable history pages. History opens bounded pages and original reasons. Routine work and food have exact daily counters; recent and linked evidence stays inspectable. Active-item indexes and exact interval calculations reduce repeated physical work. Display evidence shares immutable records, with a bounded lead over the screen.

Snapshots publish complete pages before journal compaction. Wall-time saves now also have a game-year checkpoint cap, so the fallback frontier advances during fast play. Recovery from a damaged newest snapshot matches uninterrupted state.

## What to try

Open a fresh camp, inspect a spent input and its original decision in History, then reopen. Try large text and rotation. Read the three reasons for a person's choice. Older builds' camps are refused; this is save format 9.

[Check APK 50102](../build/apk-check/kindling-50102-check.apk) · [Checksum](../build/apk-check/kindling-50102-check.apk.sha256). 29,597,707 bytes (28.227 MiB); built from final source in 125 seconds.

Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase. The coordinator signs releases; the release APK was not written by this delivery.

[Coordinator's release APK](https://github.com/gunsandsalvi/Project-Nature/raw/ccr-13ab6fef-fspju6/dist/kindling.apk) remains under the coordinator's control. Check certificates cannot update its installation.

## What is rough

P1 remains pending: the owner approved α4.1c's value repair before that unchanged gate. The unchanged 19-day calibration runs at 0.620 game years/minute, below the target. Reprocessing already edible food dominates work; no physical chances, yields or knowledge were changed here. Display stress fell from 4.45 GiB to 384 MiB. Storage savings depend on the older recoverable snapshot frontier; no universal percentage or long-run bound is claimed.

[M4 checks and commits](M4-CHECKS.md) and [cost evidence](M4-1B-COST.json) record recovery, determinism, memory, timings and the routine sections. Remaining M4 gates, seasonal/body/family work, phone performance/play/battery evidence and final trimmed audit are ahead. Independent review follows that audit.
